title: The idea is good, but there's issues
body: The app idea is pretty cool, but the rabbit gets sad too quickly and then is very hard to recover health. I have few habits because I'm starting a healthier lifestyle slowly, and the fact that fulfilling my habits everyday isn't enough to keep the rabbit's health (and the points per activity completed) is very disappointing and discouraging.

title: Superou minhas expectativas!
body:
Encontrei um App que me impulsiona a cumprir minhas metas e compromissos. 
Ele é suuuuper fofo, e me faz querer, além de realizar o que tenho que fazer, organizar todo o cantinho do Habbit! Sério, eu baixei muitos aplicativos, mas esse foi o único que me fez querer fazer o que tinha que fazer. 
Desejo muito sucesso para os criadores, não desistam desse App, ele tem mudado a minha vida. 
Agora… licença, vou organizar a toca do meu habbit.
author: clarinhaaajabi

title: Widgets?
body:
The app is perfect, I mean, there are somethings I don’t actually like about it, like, seems it doesn’t fit my screen well? Anyway, the only thing I would like to add here is some widgets, but not sure how hard it would be to add this, so okaaay. :)
The offline mode is paid but only one time and may be worthy if you enjoy the app and use it.
I am happy to see their work, in apps like StudyBunny and HabitRabit we can see the effort the developers put on the app and of course, it’s something think to help, a wonderful job that makes me happy.
Thank you for the good work and keep going! Do your best and don’t forget to rest~ 💙
